note: One entry for each page. 'published' stays empty until the site is published. 'modified' changes only when the content changes in substance, never on a rebuild or a source recheck.

pages.title: State Pension amounts and the triple lock
pages.shareTitle: State Pension amounts and the triple lock, explained
pages.purpose: Give the current full rates first, then the routes into the rules, buying power and reform.
pages.description: Understand current State Pension rates, how the triple lock works, what pensions can cover and the evidence for different reform options.
pages.modified_note: Added the announcement of 29 September 2026 and rewrote the news note.

pages.title: The State Pension: what people receive and why
pages.purpose: Explain entitlement: the two systems, qualifying years, age, claiming, tax and extra help.
pages.description: How the basic and new State Pension work, why full rates are not everyone's payment, and where Pension Credit fits. An explainer, not a personal entitlement check.

pages.title: The triple lock: how annual increases work
pages.purpose: Explain the three measures, timing, the legal minimum, exceptions and compounding. Hosts the mechanism tool.
pages.description: How prices, earnings and 2.5% set the yearly State Pension increase, with past decisions and an illustrative calculator. Results are examples, not forecasts.

pages.title: Living on a pension: what the money can cover
pages.purpose: Separate observed spending, research budgets and a household's own needs. Hosts the budget explorer.
pages.description: Research budgets, what retired households spend, and a budget explorer you fill in yourself. It does not work out tax or benefits, and nothing you enter is sent anywhere.

pages.title: Reform options: what changes, and who gains or loses
pages.purpose: Compare ways to change yearly increases and ways to change entitlement, with costs and distribution. Hosts the rule comparison tool and the dated section on pensions and social care.
pages.description: Evidence for keeping or changing the triple lock and for means-testing: costs, who is affected, and the 2026 plan to change the rule and pay for social care.
pages.modified_note: Added the rule announced for April 2030 and rewrote the social care section after the announcement of 29 September 2026.

pages.title: State Pension history: rates and increases since 2010
pages.purpose: Show published rates and decisions, with exceptional years. Hosts the history explorer.
pages.description: Full State Pension rates and the increase applied each year from 2010, with the exceptions. Comparisons under other rules are calculations, not what anyone was paid.

pages.title: Sources, method and corrections
pages.purpose: Describe sources, calculations, limits, review status, glossary and the correction process.
pages.description: Where the figures on this site come from, how the calculations work, what has and has not been checked, and how to report an error.

pages.title: Accessibility statement
pages.purpose: State the standard, what has been tested, known gaps and how to report a barrier.
pages.description: The accessibility standard this site works to, what has been tested so far, what has not, and how to report a problem.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.purpose: Explain what data the site handles and how budget inputs stay on the device.
pages.description: What this site does and does not collect. Amounts you enter in the budget explorer stay in your browser and are not sent or stored.
pages.modified_note: Names the host and the analytics planned for launch.

pages.title: Site map
pages.purpose: List the main explanations, tools and utility pages.
pages.description: A list of every page on this site, grouped into explanations, tools and information about the site.

pages.title: Page not found
pages.purpose: Shown when an address does not exist. Served with a not-found status by the host.
pages.description: There is no page at this address.
